verdict.rationale: The firm's own services page lists nationality-specific visa categories (TN for Canadians and Mexicans, E-3 for Australians) and a consular processing service for applicants outside the US. These are one-line service listings, not substantive country-specific guidance. missing for 10: dedicated pages for founders from specific countries, country backlog or priority-date guidance, consulate-specific processing guidance, depth beyond one-line listings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country

citations.quote: TN: Professional work visa for Canadians and Mexicans
E-3: Specialty occupation visa for Australians
CONSULAR PROCESSING: Process your visa from outside the US
